<h2><a href="https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/structuring-the-document/problem" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Structuring the Document</a></h2>

| | |
|---|---|
| **Difficulty** | Hard |
| **Language** | Language: C |
| **Verdict** | ✅ Accepted |
| **Problem Link** | [HackerRank Challenge](https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/structuring-the-document/problem) |

## Topics
`Structs and Enums`

---

## Problem Statement

<div class="content-text challenge-text mlB hackdown-container theme-m"><div class="challenge-body-html"><div class="challenge_problem_statement"><div class="msB challenge_problem_statement_body"><div class="hackdown-content"><svg style="display: none;"><defs id="MathJax_SVG_glyphs"></defs></svg><p>A document is represented as a collection paragraphs, a paragraph is represented as a collection of sentences, a sentence is represented as a collection of words and a word is represented as a collection of lower-case ([a-z]) and upper-case ([A-Z]) English characters.  You will convert a raw text document into its component paragraphs, sentences and words.  To test your results, queries will ask you to return a specific paragraph, sentence or word as described below.  </p>

<p>Alicia is studying the C programming language at the University of Dunkirk and she represents the words, sentences, paragraphs, and documents using pointers:</p>

<ul>
<li>A word is described by:  </li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">word</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="kt">char</span><span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">data</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="p">};</span>
</pre></div>


<ul>
<li>A sentence is described by:  </li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">sentence</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">word</span><span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">data</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">word_count</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="c1">//the number of words in a sentence</span>
<span class="p">};</span>
</pre></div>


<p>The words in the sentence are separated by one space (" "). The last word does not end with a space.  </p>

<ul>
<li>A paragraph is described by:  </li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">paragraph</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">sentence</span><span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">data</span>  <span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">sentence_count</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="c1">//the number of sentences in a paragraph</span>
<span class="p">};</span>
</pre></div>


<p>The sentences in the paragraph are separated by one period (".").</p>

<ul>
<li>A document is described by:  </li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">document</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">paragraph</span><span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">data</span><span class="p">;</span>
    <span class="kt">int</span> <span class="n">paragraph_count</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="c1">//the number of paragraphs in a document</span>
<span class="p">};</span>
</pre></div>


<p>The paragraphs in the document are separated by one newline("\n"). The last paragraph does not end with a newline.</p>

<p>For example:  </p>

<blockquote>
  <p>Learning C is fun. <br>
  Learning pointers is more fun.It is good to have pointers.</p>
</blockquote>

<ul>
<li>The only sentence in the first paragraph could be represented as:</li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">sentence</span> <span class="n">first_sentence_in_first_paragraph</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="n">first_sentence_in_first_paragraph</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s">"Learning"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"C"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"fun"</span><span class="p">};</span>
</pre></div>


<ul>
<li>The first paragraph itself could be represented as:</li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">paragraph</span> <span class="n">first_paragraph</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="n">first_paragraph</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{{</span><span class="s">"Learning"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"C"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"fun"</span><span class="p">}};</span>
</pre></div>


<ul>
<li>The first sentence in the second paragraph could be represented as:</li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">sentence</span> <span class="n">first_sentence_in_second_paragraph</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="n">first_sentence_in_second_paragraph</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s">"Learning"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"pointers"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"more"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"fun"</span><span class="p">};</span>
</pre></div>


<ul>
<li>The second sentence in the second paragraph could be represented as:</li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">sentence</span> <span class="n">second_sentence_in_second_paragraph</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="n">second_sentence_in_second_paragraph</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s">"It"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"good"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"to"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"have"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"pointers"</span><span class="p">};</span>
</pre></div>


<ul>
<li>The second paragraph could be represented as:</li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">paragraph</span> <span class="n">second_paragraph</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="n">second_paragraph</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{{</span><span class="s">"Learning"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"pointers"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"more"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"fun"</span><span class="p">},</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s">"It"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"good"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"to"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"have"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"pointers"</span><span class="p">}};</span>
</pre></div>


<ul>
<li>Finally, the document could be represented as:</li>
</ul>

<div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">struct</span> <span class="n">document</span> <span class="n">Doc</span><span class="p">;</span>
<span class="n">Doc</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{{{</span><span class="s">"Learning"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"C"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"fun"</span><span class="p">}},</span> <span class="p">{{</span><span class="s">"Learning"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"pointers"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"more"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"fun"</span><span class="p">},</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s">"It"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"is"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"good"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"to"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"have"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s">"pointers"</span><span class="p">}}};</span>
</pre></div>
